_comment: Copy to monitor_config.json and fill in. monitor_config.json is gitignored (keeps secrets off GitHub).
_split_deploy_comment: Dashboard (laptop) reaches the worker (Jetson) by HOSTNAME, not IP. On the LAPTOP set worker_host to the Jetson's mDNS name; for an all-in-one PC test use 127.0.0.1.
_feeder_method_comment: 1 = whole feeder, 2 = open area, 3 = demo/dummy farm (uses Method 2's model until a Method-3 model is trained)
_tz_comment: Timestamps are STORED in UTC; the dashboard DISPLAYS them shifted by this offset. Malaysia (MYT) = 8.
